examples.hanzi: 对不起，耽误你一点时间。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, dānwu nǐ yīdiǎn shíjiān.
examples.english: Sorry to take up a bit of your time.

examples.hanzi: 别为了玩游戏耽误了学习。
examples.pinyin: Bié wèile wán yóuxì dānwu le xuéxí.
examples.english: Don't let playing games hold back your studies.

examples.hanzi: 请告诉我精确的时间和地点。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ jīngquè de shíjiān hé dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Please tell me the exact time and place.

examples.hanzi: 他的计算非常精确，一点错误也没有。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìsuàn fēicháng jīngquè, yīdiǎn cuòwù yě méiyǒu.
examples.english: His calculation is very precise, without a single error.

examples.hanzi: 天太冷了，流浪汉睡在地铁站里。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài lěng le, liúlànghàn shuì zài dìtiězhàn lǐ.
examples.english: It was so cold that the homeless man slept in the subway station.

examples.hanzi: 我给那个流浪汉买了一份热饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nàge liúlànghàn mǎi le yī fèn rè fàn.
examples.english: I bought a hot meal for that homeless man.

examples.hanzi: 他是个大块头，可是性格很温柔。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì gè dàkuàitóu, kěshì xìnggé hěn wēnróu.
examples.english: He's a big guy, but he has a gentle nature.

examples.hanzi: 这个大块头一进门，屋子就显得小了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàkuàitóu yī jìn mén, wūzi jiù xiǎnde xiǎo le.
examples.english: The moment this big guy walked in, the room seemed smaller.

examples.hanzi: 请代我向你父母问候一声。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dài wǒ xiàng nǐ fùmǔ wènhòu yī shēng.
examples.english: Please say hello to your parents for me.

examples.hanzi: 新年到了，大家互相问候，送上祝福。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián dào le, dàjiā hùxiāng wènhòu, sòng shàng zhùfú.
examples.english: With the New Year here, everyone exchanges greetings and good wishes.

examples.hanzi: 我在开车，只能给你发语音。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài kāichē, zhǐ néng gěi nǐ fā yǔyīn.
examples.english: I'm driving, so I can only send you a voice message.

examples.hanzi: 学外语时，语音是最需要先打好的基础。
examples.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ shí, yǔyīn shì zuì xūyào xiān dǎhǎo de jīchǔ.
examples.english: When learning a foreign language, pronunciation is the foundation to get right first.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在院子里点燃了小烟花。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài yuànzi lǐ diǎnrán le xiǎo yānhuā.
examples.english: The children lit small fireworks in the yard.

examples.hanzi: 这场精彩的演讲点燃了大家的热情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng jīngcǎi de yǎnjiǎng diǎnrán le dàjiā de rèqíng.
examples.english: This brilliant speech ignited everyone's enthusiasm.

examples.hanzi: 同事结婚，我随了五百块份子。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì jiéhūn, wǒ suí le wǔbǎi kuài fènzi.
examples.english: My colleague got married, and I gave a cash gift of five hundred yuan.

examples.hanzi: 过年时，亲戚们都要凑份子请客。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, qīnqimen dōu yào còu fènzi qǐngkè.
examples.english: At New Year, the relatives all chip in to host a meal.

examples.hanzi: 这家公司的福利待遇很不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de fúlì dàiyù hěn bùcuò.
examples.english: This company offers quite good benefits and pay.

examples.hanzi: 他在国外受到了很好的待遇。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài shòudào le hěn hǎo de dàiyù.
examples.english: He was treated very well abroad.

examples.hanzi: 在法律之上，没有人享有特权。
examples.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ zhīshàng, méiyǒu rén xiǎngyǒu tèquán.
examples.english: No one is above the law.

examples.hanzi: 飞机飞到了云层之上。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī fēi dào le yúncéng zhīshàng.
examples.english: The plane flew above the clouds.

examples.hanzi: 以前人们靠写信通信，现在有手机了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián rénmen kào xiěxìn tōngxìn, xiànzài yǒu shǒujī le.
examples.english: People used to correspond by letter, but now there are phones.

examples.hanzi: 台风过后，这个地区的通信中断了。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guòhòu, zhège dìqū de tōngxìn zhōngduàn le.
examples.english: After the typhoon, communications in this area were cut off.

examples.hanzi: 这个软件可以模拟真实的考试环境。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ mónǐ zhēnshí de kǎoshì huánjìng.
examples.english: This software can simulate a real exam environment.

examples.hanzi: 下周我们要参加模拟考试。
examples.pinyin: Xià zhōu wǒmen yào cānjiā mónǐ kǎoshì.
examples.english: Next week we're taking a practice exam.

examples.hanzi: 宝宝张开嘴，等着妈妈喂饭。
examples.pinyin: Bǎobao zhāngkāi zuǐ, děng zhe māma wèi fàn.
examples.english: The baby opened her mouth, waiting for Mom to feed her.

examples.hanzi: 他张开双臂，热情地拥抱了我。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhāngkāi shuāng bì, rèqíng de yōngbào le wǒ.
examples.english: He spread his arms and gave me a warm hug.

examples.hanzi: 这件事有点棘手，我得想想办法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǒudiǎn jíshǒu, wǒ děi xiǎngxiang bànfǎ.
examples.english: This matter is a bit tricky, so I need to think of a way.

examples.hanzi: 老板交给我一个棘手的任务。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn jiāo gěi wǒ yī gè jíshǒu de rènwu.
examples.english: The boss gave me a thorny task.

examples.hanzi: 过量饮酒对身体不好。
examples.pinyin: Guòliàng yǐnjiǔ duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
examples.english: Drinking excessively is bad for your health.

examples.hanzi: 这种药过量会有副作用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào guòliàng huì yǒu fùzuòyòng.
examples.english: Taking too much of this medicine has side effects.

examples.hanzi: 她紧紧握着我的手，不愿意放开。
examples.pinyin: Tā jǐnjǐn wò zhe wǒ de shǒu, bù yuànyì fàngkāi.
examples.english: She held my hand tightly and didn't want to let go.

examples.hanzi: 我们的生活紧紧联系在一起。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de shēnghuó jǐnjǐn liánxì zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: Our lives are closely tied together.

examples.hanzi: 行动胜过千言万语。
examples.pinyin: Xíngdòng shèngguò qiān yán wàn yǔ.
examples.english: Actions speak louder than words.

examples.hanzi: 这家小店的味道胜过很多大餐厅。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de wèidào shèngguò hěn duō dà cāntīng.
examples.english: This little shop's food tastes better than many big restaurants.

examples.hanzi: 我在门口拦住了正要出去的弟弟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài ménkǒu lánzhù le zhèng yào chūqù de dìdi.
examples.english: I stopped my younger brother at the door as he was about to go out.

examples.hanzi: 一条小河拦住了我们的去路。
examples.pinyin: Yī tiáo xiǎo hé lánzhù le wǒmen de qùlù.
examples.english: A small river blocked our way.

examples.hanzi: 维多利亚港的夜景非常漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Wéiduōlìyà gǎng de yèjǐng fēicháng piàoliang.
examples.english: The night view of Victoria Harbour is beautiful.

examples.hanzi: 我的朋友在加拿大的维多利亚市工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyou zài Jiānádà de Wéiduōlìyà shì gōngzuò.
examples.english: My friend works in Victoria, Canada.

examples.hanzi: 运动可以帮助保持血管健康。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng kěyǐ bāngzhù bǎochí xuèguǎn jiànkāng.
examples.english: Exercise helps keep your blood vessels healthy.

examples.hanzi: 护士很快就找到了他手臂上的血管。
examples.pinyin: Hùshi hěn kuài jiù zhǎodào le tā shǒubì shàng de xuèguǎn.
examples.english: The nurse quickly found the vein in his arm.

examples.hanzi: 这只小狗有一半的德国血统。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu yǒu yībàn de Déguó xuètǒng.
examples.english: This puppy is half German by breed.

examples.hanzi: 他有着中国和法国的混合血统。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒuzhe Zhōngguó hé Fǎguó de hùnhé xuètǒng.
examples.english: He is of mixed Chinese and French descent.

examples.hanzi: 我姨妈做的红烧肉特别好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yímā zuò de hóngshāoròu tèbié hǎochī.
examples.english: The braised pork my aunt makes is especially delicious.

examples.hanzi: 姨妈和妈妈长得很像。
examples.pinyin: Yímā hé māma zhǎng de hěn xiàng.
examples.english: My aunt and my mom look very much alike.

examples.hanzi: 今后有问题，随时给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Jīnhòu yǒu wèntí, suíshí gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: From now on, call me anytime you have a problem.

examples.hanzi: 希望你今后不要再迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ jīnhòu bù yào zài chídào le.
examples.english: I hope you won't be late again in the future.

examples.hanzi: 这件事你放心，我来摆平。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ lái bǎipíng.
examples.english: Don't worry about this, I'll sort it out.

examples.hanzi: 经理很快就把客户之间的矛盾摆平了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ hěn kuài jiù bǎ kèhù zhījiān de máodùn bǎipíng le.
examples.english: The manager quickly settled the conflict between the clients.

examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen yǒu wèntí kěyǐ xiànzài tíwèn.
examples.english: Students, you may ask questions now if you have any.

examples.pinyin: Jìzhě xiàng shìzhǎng tíwèn le sān gè wèntí.
examples.english: The reporter asked the mayor three questions.

examples.english: His pocket was stuffed with crumpled banknotes.

examples.english: These days many people don't use cash and just pay with their phones.

examples.pinyin: Yī zhī xiǎoniǎo fēi jìn le jiàoshì.
examples.english: A little bird flew into the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài shù xià wèi xiǎoniǎo chī miànbāoxiè.
examples.english: The children are feeding bread crumbs to the little birds under the tree.

examples.english: This well-known writer will visit our school next month.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài guónèi wài dōu shì zhīmíng de shèjìshī.
examples.english: She is a famous designer both at home and abroad.

examples.english: Children can't always depend on their parents.

examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de jīngjì yīlài lǚyóuyè.
examples.english: This city's economy depends on tourism.

examples.english: Lincoln is the city we will visit on this trip.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào Línkěn jìniàntáng zài nǎlǐ ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the Lincoln Memorial is?

examples.english: This actor portrayed the character very vividly.

examples.english: This old song was reinterpreted by a young singer.

examples.pinyin: Tā hē kāfēi hē shàngyǐn le, yī tiān bù hē jiù nánshòu.
examples.english: He's hooked on coffee and feels awful if he skips a day.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànshìjù hěn róngyì ràng rén shàngyǐn.
examples.english: This TV series can easily get you hooked.

examples.english: My neighbor is a Muslim and doesn't eat pork.

examples.english: This restaurant serves halal food specially for Muslim customers.

examples.english: It rained heavily last night.

examples.english: It's very cold at night, so remember to use an extra quilt.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yī kuǎn dǐngjí de zhuānyè xiàngjī.
examples.english: This is a top-of-the-line professional camera.

examples.hanzi: 他请客户去了城里顶级的酒店。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐng kèhù qù le chéng lǐ dǐngjí de jiǔdiàn.
examples.english: He took the client to the city's top hotel.

examples.hanzi: 你今天气色不太好，是不是没睡好？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān qìsè bù tài hǎo, shì bu shì méi shuì hǎo?
examples.english: You don't look well today. Did you not sleep well?

examples.hanzi: 奶奶最近气色红润，精神也很好。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zuìjìn qìsè hóngrùn, jīngshén yě hěn hǎo.
examples.english: Grandma has a rosy complexion lately and is in good spirits.

examples.pinyin: Tā de yìtú hěn míngxiǎn, jiùshì xiǎng piàn wǒmen.
examples.english: His intention is obvious: he wants to trick us.

examples.hanzi: 我没有意图伤害任何人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu yìtú shānghài rènhé rén.
examples.english: I have no intention of hurting anyone.

examples.pinyin: Tuánduì hézuò shì zhè jiā gōngsī de héxīn jiàzhí.
examples.english: Teamwork is this company's core value.

examples.hanzi: 他是球队的核心球员。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì qiúduì de héxīn qiúyuán.
examples.english: He is the core player of the team.

examples.hanzi: 我在餐厅打工，一个小时三十块。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài cāntīng dǎgōng, yī gè xiǎoshí sānshí kuài.
examples.english: I work part-time at a restaurant for thirty yuan an hour.

examples.hanzi: 很多农村人到大城市打工。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō nóngcūn rén dào dà chéngshì dǎgōng.
examples.english: Many rural people go to big cities to work.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào jiāndìng zìjǐ de xìnxīn.
examples.english: We should strengthen our confidence.

examples.hanzi: 他坚定的眼神让我相信他会成功。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiāndìng de yǎnshén ràng wǒ xiāngxìn tā huì chénggōng.
examples.english: His determined gaze made me believe he would succeed.

examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà kāifā zhè piàn huāngdì.
examples.english: The government plans to develop this wasteland.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de tuánduì zhèngzài kāifā yī gè xīn de shǒujī yìngyòng.
examples.english: Our team is developing a new mobile app.

examples.hanzi: 这座城市在节日里热闹非凡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì zài jiérì lǐ rènao fēifán.
examples.english: The city is extraordinarily lively during the festival.

examples.hanzi: 他有着非凡的记忆力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒuzhe fēifán de jìyìlì.
examples.english: He has an extraordinary memory.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ liǎnsè zhème chà, shì bu shì shēngbìng le?
examples.english: You look so pale. Are you ill?

examples.hanzi: 老板的脸色一下子沉了下来。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn de liǎnsè yīxiàzi chén le xiàlái.
examples.english: The boss's expression suddenly turned grim.

examples.hanzi: 她很会倾听，大家都愿意跟她聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn huì qīngtīng, dàjiā dōu yuànyì gēn tā liáotiān.
examples.english: She is a great listener, so everyone likes chatting with her.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī nàixīn de qīngtīng měi gè xuésheng de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: The teacher patiently listens to every student's ideas.

examples.pinyin: Tā zuótiān qù yínháng tíqǔ le wǔqiān kuài qián.
examples.english: He went to the bank yesterday and withdrew five thousand yuan.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng mìmǎ cóng zìdòng qǔkuǎnjī tíqǔ xiànjīn.
examples.english: You can withdraw cash from the ATM with a PIN.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì gè hǎo rìzi, wǒmen qù lǐng zhèng ba.
examples.english: Today is an auspicious day, so let's go register our marriage.

examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒmen zhōngyú guò shàng le hǎo rìzi.
examples.english: Now we are finally living a good life.

examples.pinyin: Děngdào nǐ lái de shíhou, wǒmen yǐjīng chī wán le.
examples.english: By the time you arrive, we'll have finished eating.

examples.hanzi: 等到春天来了，我们就去郊游。
examples.pinyin: Děngdào chūntiān lái le, wǒmen jiù qù jiāoyóu.
examples.english: When spring comes, we'll go on an outing.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào jiāqiáng Yīngyǔ kǒuyǔ de liànxí.
examples.english: We need to step up our spoken English practice.

examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào jiāqiáng le duì xuésheng ānquán de guǎnlǐ.
examples.english: The school has tightened its management of student safety.

examples.hanzi: 手机没电了，哪里有电源可以充电？
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī méi diàn le, nǎlǐ yǒu diànyuán kěyǐ chōngdiàn?
examples.english: My phone is dead. Where is there a power outlet to charge it?

examples.hanzi: 修理之前，请先关闭电源。
examples.pinyin: Xiūlǐ zhīqián, qǐng xiān guānbì diànyuán.
examples.english: Please turn off the power before repairing it.

examples.hanzi: 电梯坏了，工人正在维修。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī huài le, gōngrén zhèngzài wéixiū.
examples.english: The elevator is broken, and workers are repairing it.

examples.hanzi: 这辆车的维修费用太高了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de wéixiū fèiyòng tài gāo le.
examples.english: The repair costs for this car are too high.
